answer: The wiki exists because the owner wanted the agent's working memory held in the open, in versioned files, instead of inside the agent — and the founding decisions stand as the owner made them: a blanket approval covers work, never decisions.

citation_details.passage: This wiki exists because the owner chose to hold the agent's context visibly, in versioned files anyone can inspect, rather than in the agent's own memory
The owner reversed the blanket direction the same day: decisions are NOT covered by it — every decision needs the owner's own approval.
